newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia opens 463 mln rgt R & D technology park.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia opens 463 mln rgt R & D technology park.

text.p: Malaysian Prime Minister Mahathir Mohamad on Thursday opened a 463 million ringgit ($185 million) technological park to serve as the nerve centre for the nation's research and development (R & D) efforts.
The 280-hectare Technology Park Malaysia is located south of Kuala Lumpur and next to an evolving cyber-city or information hub, dubbed the "Multimedia Super Corridor", Bernama news agency reported.
The park is designed to be fully equipped with fibre optics, Internet communication and prototyping facilities, Bernama said.
It quoted Mahathir as saying that Malaysia had to leap-frog into the electronics sector and required people as intelligent and trained as those who gave Europe its industrial edge.
"I'm sure Malaysians can master the skill. It is a matter of applying yourself...Try we must and succeed we will," Mahathir said.

Bernama said the first phase of the park costing 237 million ringgit was ready and focused on information technology, software development, microelectronics, telecommunications and aerospace technology.
The second phase, projected to cost 226 million ringgit, will be completed by 2000.
It will promote research and development for biotechnology, medical and environmental technology, agriculture, health, energy and pollution control.
